device.basis: Table memory of X-T20 2.11 imaging, one page of four (0xfff43000..0xfff46fff). Section-5 loaders at 0xc3dd40.. (0xc3dd64..0xc3e960, each through the register helper 0x5ab4c) fill nine 64-word tables at 0xfff43200 + 0x100*n from four bytes each and twelve 256-word tables at 0xfff43c00 + 0x400*n, packing three 10-bit fields per word; the recording start-up reaches 0xc3e538 after lens step 0x01091300. Section 6 copies the same tables back word by word (0x169c27c.., 0x169b8f8), so the words read back their last write. No status word is known; what the tables do is not modeled.
